Container.Name: keystone-db
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 16 — Keystone's tenant-private datastore (row-level security). Stock postgres:16 (NOT TimescaleDB — Keystone's schema is relational multi-tenant, no hypertables). Neutral template: bridge networking + no baked IP — set network mode / static IP + POSTGRES_PASSWORD at container creation. Autostart this DB BEFORE the keystone app container.
Container.Description: PostgreSQL 16 for Keystone. Neutral template; set IP + POSTGRES_PASSWORD at creation.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Postgres data dir. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL, NOT the user-share FUSE overlay.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: DB password (set at creation; reuse as the app's DB_PASSWORD)
